name: The-Sims-Medieval-iOS-vita
description: iOS to PSVita Port of The Sims Medieval
long_description: An unofficial, native **iOS-to-PS Vita wrapper port** of *The Sims Medieval* for iPad (v1.0.1, 32-bit ARMv7 Mach-O). A custom Mach-O loader runs the original executable on the Vita, while Apple's UIKit and Foundation calls are replaced by a high-level emulation (HLE) layer and rendering goes through vitaGL.
